title: Worklist
lede: Everything that needs a decision today, ranked, with the reason it is here.

rest.label: Rest
rest.note: Five rows, ranked. The top row is the only accented element.

loading.label: Loading
loading.note: Five row-shaped skeletons, so the page does not resize when data lands.

empty.label: Empty
empty.note: Nothing to decide before 2pm. Says what will bring rows here, not just that there are none.

error.label: Error
error.copy: Couldn't reach the calendar. Retry, or work from what was cached at 06:12.

partial.label: Partial
partial.note: Mail arrived, calendar did not. The missing source is named in the header, not hidden.

offline.label: Offline
offline.note: Cached rows stay readable and every action that needs the network is disabled with a reason.

destructive.note: Undo for 8s in the same row; no dialog.

audit.absorbs: ranking five heterogeneous sources into one order, and explaining the rank in one clause per row
audit.transfers: the user still picks which row to act on; the product does not act unasked
audit.claim: median time from open to first action, measured, not the number of taps

flow.residue: the row leaves and the count drops
the row returns at the named time, not vaguely later
cached rows remain, the header names what is missing
